name: Crafty Controller
description: Crafty 4 is the next iteration of our Minecraft Server Wrapper / Controller / Launcher.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-crafty application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-crafty
  # The `big-bear-crafty` service definition
  big-bear-crafty:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-crafty
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: registry.gitlab.com/crafty-controller/crafty-4:4.10.4@sha256:d2f61fcabb4756a63bc8538fb4f5e35ffddca3f1916a733c95a31c705c697742
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC
    # Ports mapping between host and container HOST:CONTAINER
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8443" # Web UI
      - 8123:8123
      - 19132:19132/udp
      - 25500-25600:25500-25600
    # Volumes mapping between host and container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/backups:/crafty/backups
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/logs:/crafty/logs
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/servers:/crafty/servers
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/config:/crafty/app/config
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/import:/crafty/import
